meta.description: ItemConfigurator.changeMode called the way PacketModeChange.handle calls it (ItemAccessUtils.forEntitySlot(player, MAINHAND), a root transaction committed after), from every mode.
meta.fields: mode (the mode before), shift, display (DisplayChange name), canAccess (IItemSecurityUtils.canAccess), after (the mode ItemConfigurator.getMode answers for the main hand stack after the call), changed (after != mode), component (the CONFIGURATOR_MODE component of the main hand stack, serialized name or null), is_default (component equals configurate_items), patch (component patch keys of the stack after), count (stack count), overlay (the ClientboundSystemChatPacket overlay=true messages the player received, Component JSON, in order), chat (the non overlay system messages), payloads (ids of the custom payloads the player received: 'mekanism:show_mode_change' is Mekanism.packetHandler().showModeChange, which DisplayChange.MAIN_HAND calls), show_mode_change (payloads contains it).
